verdict.rationale: Workers documents rolling back to a previously deployed version via Wrangler or the dashboard, which also implies a versioned deployment history. The platform says it fits into existing Git and GitHub Actions workflows, so automation code can be source-controlled and reviewed through standard Git processes. missing for 10: an explicit first-party review/approval step for deployments (e.g. preview or staged rollout of a version before promotion), detailed documentation of the version-management model, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the rollback flow.
